speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to the clinic. I see you are presenting with generalized fatigue, severe itching, and abnormal liver function tests. Also, have you noticed any jaundice, dark urine, or pale stools?

speaker: Patient
text: 32-year-old male. The patient reports a 2-month history of increasing generalized fatigue and severe pruritus. He has known hypertension and was diagnosed with ulcerative colitis 5 years ago. He mentions being sexually active with 2 female partners and inconsistent condom use.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for providing that history. Your background with Ulcerative Colitis and multiple sexual partners raises concern for Hepatitis B or C, but we must also consider extrahepatic causes. Have you noticed any recent weight loss, night sweats, or new abdominal pain?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Generalized fatigue and severe pruritus. I also have Scleral icterus, Multiple scratch marks on trunk and extremities.

speaker: Doctor
text:
The presence of scleral icterus alongside severe pruritus and fatigue strongly suggests cholestasis. Given your history of Ulcerative Colitis and sexual activity, are you currently taking any medications like sulfasalazine, or have you had any recent blood transfusions or tattoos?
